parts.one_line: Test security, against the product profile's security level: the built work is tested for security, at rest and while it runs in the testing environment, against the security level the product profile commits to, and each finding goes back to the developer or to a person.

Once the work is built, tests the whole built code at rest, by a part that is not the builder, for weaknesses in how it is written, for libraries with known weaknesses and for any secret's value, and compares each result with the profile's pass bar and each capability's security need.

Once the built work runs in the testing environment, tries on its declared surfaces what the pass bar and each capability's security need say to try, with the environment's made-up data and test accounts, and never touches anything outside that environment.

Gives one verdict for the built work against the profile's security level, with a pass or a fail for every part of the pass bar and each capability's security need, and sends each finding back as a handoff plan to the developer when the builder can fix it alone, or to the product owner when a person must decide.

Runs the security tests again after a fix, when more work is built, and when an approved decision raises the security level, keeps each verdict, names what passed before and fails now, and sends a finding that keeps coming back to a person once the rounds the project allows are used up.
